heading: FAQ’s on Chat App App Development Solutions

items.question: Can the app be customised?
items.answer: Yes. Branding, features and workflows can be tailored to your idea.

items.question: Is end-to-end encryption available?
items.answer: Yes. We can implement end-to-end encryption and other security options depending on your requirements.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on customisation and extra features.

items.question: Can it support voice and video calls?
items.answer: Yes. Voice and video calling can be added to one-to-one and group chats.

items.question: How many users can it support?
items.answer: The backend is built to scale, and capacity grows with your infrastructure.

items.question: How much does a chat app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on the feature set and platforms. Share your requirements for an estimate.
